name: Shadow Watcher
tactics: A shadow watcher monitors movement invisibly. When a trespasser approaches, it wings forward to slash with its shadow talons. While its foe deals with its newfound vulnerability, the shadow watcher plunges into the target and seizes its mind.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Four individual Tiny creatures can fit in a square, and a Tiny creature can enter a larger creature’s space and end its turn there. Having a reach of 0 means a Tiny creature cannot make melee attacks against targets outside its own space, unless otherwise noted.

traits.name: Gloaming
traits.details: bright light in the aura is instead dim light, and dim light in the aura is dark.

traits.name: Combat Advantage
traits.details: The shadow watcher’s shadow talons attack deals 2d6 extra necrotic damage to targets it has combat advantage against.

auras.name: Gloaming
auras.details: bright light in the aura is instead dim light, and dim light in the aura is dark.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target gains vulnerable 10 necrotic (save ends)

powers.name: Shadow Plunge
powers.usageDetails: when it hits with shadow talons
powers.range: The shadow watcher flies 6 squares and makes an attack at any point during that movement: targets creatures with vulnerable necrotic
powers.description: The shadow watcher exits the creature’s space into any unoccupied adjacent space

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.range: The shadow watcher flies 6 squares and makes an attack at any point during that movement: targets creatures with vulnerable necrotic

hit.description: on a hit, the shadow watcher enters the target’s space without provoking an opportunity attack and perches on the target’s shoulder. The target is dominated and takes ongoing 15 necrotic damage (save ends both). While the target is dominated, the shadow watcher gains insubstantial, but cannot take standard, move, or minor actions (see also invisible at rest).

aftereffects.name: Aftereffect
aftereffects.description: The shadow watcher exits the creature’s space into any unoccupied adjacent space

powers.name: Invisible at Rest
powers.trigger: when the shadow watcher does not move on its turn

effect.description: The shadow watcher becomes invisible until the start of its next turn.
